releaseStatus: Run on the source of STX 0.2.870, which adds this suite and changes no published code

craft.note: Both appearances were run through the gate itself, which generated the host app from this clean checkout each time. An earlier pass against Craft c8ba180d921d gave the same 4 of 4 in each appearance and the same audit findings; this commit changed packages/ios after it (grid track counts and the floating-actions clearance in CraftNativeScreen.swift).

method: XCUITest reads the accessibility tree VoiceOver reads. These are assertions on that tree and on Apple's performAccessibilityAudit(), not a recording of VoiceOver speaking, which a simulator cannot run.

tests.testEachControlHasItsRoleAndName: Button (words and a bound ariaLabel), TextInput (accessibilityLabel and placeholder), Checkbox and Switch (label) are each exposed as one element of the right kind with the name a reader hears.
tests.testStateIsAnnouncedAndFollowsTheControl: A bound button name changes with its signal; a disabled button is not announced as usable; a switch reports 0 then 1; a checked box is announced differently from an unchecked one; a text field reports what was typed.
tests.testControlsAreReachedInTheOrderWritten: Each control is exposed exactly once, and top to bottom they are in the order the screen was written.
tests.testSystemAccessibilityAudit: Every audit type runs. The findings below are listed in the test per appearance; any other finding fails it, and so does a listed one that is no longer reported.
